artworks.title: Achilles Dragging Hector's Body
artworks.description: Hayez's chariot round the wall — the outrage that would move Zeus to send Priam with ransom.

artworks.title: Achilles Vanquishes Hector
artworks.description: Rubens' Achilles tapestry design: the duel outside Troy's walls — Hector falls, Achilles' spear the hinge of Iliad 22.

artworks.title: Triumphant Achilles
artworks.description: Matsch's Achilleion fresco: Achilles drives his chariot before Troy, dragging Hector's body in the dust as the city watches from the ramparts.

artworks.title: Andromache Mourning Hector
artworks.description: David's reception piece: Andromache grieves beside Hector on his bier — the lament that answers the duel and closes the Iliad's greatest death.

films.title: Troy
films.description: Petersen's blockbuster stages the Achilles–Hector duel as its climax — Brad Pitt and Eric Bana on the sand outside the walls.
